name: agent-server
title: Optimistic-concurrency coordination server
interface: An HTTP API in the shape of prove2me's: publish contract, submit implementation/decomposition, async verify queue with verdict polling, frontier endpoint, full-text + natural-language search over contracts and submissions (including failed ones), per-account in-flight caps.
nl_description: OPEN. v0.1 is git-native (branches carry attempts, CI is the verifier). The server form removes the git bottleneck for large agent swarms, exactly as prove2me found PR review to be the scaling limit.
